subject: The hour that heals most
preview_text: Power users know this one trick that cuts recovery time — it's not what you think.
body_paragraphs: There's an hour in the day when your brain is raw, open, and ready to rewrite itself — and most people waste it. The hour after you wake up, before the noise of the world floods in, your ex's voice is still quiet. Power users in Fresh Start know this window is pure gold.

Here's the shortcut nobody talks about: open the app the moment your eyes open, not at 3AM when you're spiraling. In that first hour, your mood tracker is 80% more accurate because the day hasn't hit you yet. The guided exercises land deeper because your defenses are down. I've seen users shave weeks off their healing by just moving their check-in to 6AM instead of midnight.

The app's 'Morning Reset' flow — which most people never try — is designed for this exact moment. It's a 5-minute sequence: rate your mood, write one sentence about what you deserve today, then let the AI therapist ask a single question that rewires your morning. The data shows users who do this see a 40% faster drop in obsessive thoughts.

Try it tomorrow. Set an alarm 10 minutes early, open Fresh Start, and tap the 'Morning Reset' tile on your home screen. You'll feel the difference by lunch. P.S. — The real hack? Do it for 7 days straight. That's when the neural pathways shift and the cravings start to loosen.
